lines.en: Neither one of us gets particularly inebriated tonight, but I still walk Imani home because I am a good person who does good things.
Just sometimes, the good things I do disguise themselves as bad ones.
But not in the fact that I’ve necessarily done something wrong. Just that I’ve done something that’s led to some sort of unfortunate consequence.
Like a good friend doubting herself or the...many people I’ve made inadvertently miserable by virtue of just existing in the way I have to.
As an icon of all things tempting.
An unworthy god among a congregation of blindly loyal servants.
Or a lecherous shepherd guiding a herd of prized sheep.
I doubt Imani sees me as any of those specifically-
But when I’m face to face with her in a manner in which I know she wants to invite me inside, I can’t help but open myself up to these self-aggrandizing approximations.
: Sorry that nobody else was able to make it, Senpai. I...honestly had no idea that was going to happen. If I did, I wouldn’t have invited you.
: Why not?
: Well...you know, like...it’s just not a thing we normally do alone.
: I’ve been to your house alone before and I think, if anything, that would be even weirder. Going out to drink is completely normal.
: Yeah...Yeah. You’re right. I don’t know what I’m saying.
: I just didn’t want you to assume that this was some kind of date or anything since you’re already, like...you know...dating a superstar. And I kind of suck by comparison.
: In the least self-loathing way possible, though. Like, it’s less that I actually suck and more that just...I’m not a famous idol. Or something.
: Imani, I’m not seeing Niki because she’s famous. I’m seeing her because she gets me. In a way that I don’t think anyone else really does yet.
: Well, it’s...not like you make it easy, Senpai. So kudos to her for that. Girl really did put the work in, I guess.
: She did. And a lot of it. But it’s exactly that that makes me not worth whatever you’re beating yourself up over right now.
: What are you talking about? I’m not beating myself up over anything, Senpai. You’re just imagining things.
: If I’m just imagining things, that means everyone is imagining things. You know that tonight wasn’t just an accident. Everyone bailed on purpose so the two of us would be alone.
: And if you want to keep pretending like that’s not the case and forcing yourself to not say anything that might make things weird between us, don’t. That’s not the kind of relationship I-
: Do you want to come inside?
: Never mind. Forget I said that.
: I’ve been inside before, Imani.
: Not...like this, you haven’t. This is different.
: Imani...can I ask you something?
: Sure...yeah.
: Do you think there’s something wrong with the way things are between us right now?
: What? No. That’s not it at all.
: Then...are you just not worried about that dynamic changing or something?
: I’m just trying to figure out why I’m the one who’s worried about ruining our relationship when I’m essentially always of the mindset that sex makes everything better.

: I don’t...I don’t want to ruin our relationship, Senpai. You’re my best friend. Wakana too, of course. But I see you way more than her and the mere...thought of that gets me out of bed some mornings.
: And, to be totally honest, I am worried about ruining that. I’ve been worried about it for a while. Why else would I have been so hesitant to have this discussion?
: The jig is up. I like you. We both know it. And there’s no reason to hide it anymore, so...I’m not going to bother trying. But if you don’t like me-
: I do like you. Isn’t that obvious?
: What?! No! I could have sworn you were signposting the exact opposite of that all night!
: Yeah, that’s fair. I guess I’m kind of hard to understand at times.
: You think?! Change your facial expression every once in a while or something! Leaving your feelings all up to guesswork can mess with a person’s head!
: Yeah, but so can feelings as a whole.
: Don’t change the topic! Tell me more about how and why you like me!
: You’re funny. And weird — but in a way that’s more entertaining than off-putting.

: You do virtually all of my work for me and, despite complaining about it, I know you kind of enjoy it. Plus, the way you pester me all the time is actually a little heartwarming now that I’ve gotten used to it.
: Or at least it would be heartwarming if I actually had a...well, heart.
: You keep my life at a good level of chaotic, but counteract it by helping me organize things I’d never bother with on my own. And all of the girls seem to love you as well.
: I think you’re smart and driven and I respect that you don’t normally take shit from me. And that you’re not afraid to call me out on things I don’t apply myself to.
: You and Niki are a lot alike in that regard. She’s just a little more brutally honest and less fun than you.
: Also, you’re extremely attractive and I masturbate to fantasies of you almost regularly.

: And I probably could have left that part out if I wanted, but I felt like this semi-rant was missing an element that did justice to your physical traits and that was just the first thing I thought of.
: But Senpai, if you really feel that way about me, what is there to gain from just...keeping things the way they are?
: It’s not about gaining anything. It’s about not losing something.
: I understand that I’m in a unique position when I say this, but I can have almost anyone as a partner if I want.
: But there aren’t many people I can have as friends.
: Let alone people like you, who I just...can’t really seem to find any issues with.
: Which is why I want to keep things the way they are.
: I want to keep silently looking forward to seeing you in school without worrying about betraying you or hurting you which I know I would if we were together. I can’t resist that.
: Keeping you at arm’s length is for the benefit of both of us in the long run as there’s just way too much to lose if we take the opposite route. And I don’t want to lose you.
: Did any of that make sense?
: Yeah. This is just the first time I’ve ever been friend-zoned, so I’m not really sure how to respond.

: It’s also the first time I’ve ever friend-zoned anyone. So you can take solace in the fact that you’re not alone right now. And that you were also a first for me in a very roundabout, non-ideal way.
: How long do you plan on just looking at me without saying anything?
: Until I can figure out a way to ask you if you want to come inside and have friend-sex with me.
: Ew. You too?
: Y-Yumi! Hi! Whaaaaat are you doing here?!
: Getting sick. And questioning what the fuck I must have done this time to make both of my teachers come after me this late at night.
: Nothing! Nothing at all! In fact...I was just talking about how we should be giving you extra credit since you’re such an amazing girl who would never repeat anything she just heard to anyone!
: This another trap? Cause I already fell for the poem thing and I ain’t about to let a third teacher walk all over me.
: Nonsense! I would never! In fact, why don’t all three of us take a load off in my apartment so none of my neighbors assume I’m speaking inappropriately to teenagers?!
: Imani, I don’t think Yumi wants to have friend-sex with us.
: For the first time in my life, I actually agree with him.
: Haha! Funny joke, you two! Come on in! The extra credit’s in here!
: That’d be more convincing if it didn’t sound like somebody was tryin’ to lure me into a van with candy.
: Visiting your mom again?
: She ain’t home. I just wanted something to eat.
: Are you sure you don’t want to come inside with us?
: That a joke? I ain’t ever been more sure of anything in my life.
: Please come inside, Yumi.
: What? Why? All that’ll do is prevent you from addin’ one more notch to your belt. Assumin’ it ain’t already frayed to shit from all the other ones, that is.
: Please. As a favor to me.
: You actually...don’t want to go in there. Do you?
: It’ll only take a little while. Think of it as payment for the phone you’ve had all these years that is still, somehow, not paid off.
: Throw in another IC card and you’ve got a deal. I already used up the one the goth teacher gave me.
: Done.
: Hah...should’ve asked for more. That was too easy.
Yumi resignedly walks into Imani’s apartment and I dig deeper into the depths of my mind to figure out what’s going on with me as it’s...unlike anything I’ve felt before.
By all accounts, Imani is one of the most morally correct people for me to have a physical relationship with.

Our ages aren’t all that far apart...she’s not seeing anyone....we both like each other. And, apart from the same romantic consequences that would befall any relationship I enter, no one would get hurt.
Is it because of the moral correctness that I feel so wrong about this?
Is it because there is no daughter, son, or distant relative that I’d be leading on in the process of fucking her?
Or am I really just that desperate for someone to love me in a way different from the others?
And if so...why?
I don’t get it.
I don’t get it.
: So...we good? You’re not gonna, like...tweet about this or anything?
: I’m pretty sure Yumi’s in the same social media boat as me. IE: she doesn’t give a shit.
: Yo, why the fuck does your place look all nice-ish while Yuki’s straight up sucks? Ain’t no cigarette smell or anything.
: That’s...probably on account of me not smoking. But yeah! Your mom’s my neighbor! You should come visit more often or...or something.
: Chill. I ain’t gonna tell anybody shit. And  you don’t gotta worry about bein’ all nice to me to keep me from stickin’ my hands where they don’t belong.
: Oh, thank God. Because having two secrets of mine under your belt is far too much power for me to just ignore.
: Two? What’s the first one?
: Nothing you need to be concerned about! Or will be concerned about any time soon if our current rate of progress is at all indicative of the future!
: Instead, why don’t we talk about you?! What’s new in the life of Yumi Yamaguchi? You...beat up anyone good lately? Or...
: You say that as if I just go around pickin’ fights with whoever the fuck I want.
: To be fair, I have significantly less experience with you than literally everyone else in the class on account of how frequently absent you are...So please forgive me if I’ve mischaracterized you.
: Ehh. You ain’t too far off, I guess. But I haven’t laid a finger on anybody since the Nodoka shit went down. Kinda just tryin’ to lay low at this point.
: And how’s your mom? Is she doing well?
: Fuck if I know. She can get hit by a car for all I care.
: Jesus, girl. You ain’t gotta talk about your momma like that. That shit ain’t cool.
: Cooler than abandoning your daughter so you can go suck dick for heroin or whatever it was she did all those years away. I ain’t bitter, though. Shit happens.
: I don’t know, Yumi. You sound pretty bitter. But I guess I might be too if those...circumstances are at all accurate.
: There’s gotta be something-
: Don’t touch me.
: There’s gotta be something, though! Something you’re looking forward to, I mean.
: Like, yeah. Maybe the Dorm Wars weren’t a personal highlight for you on account of how you were a pawn in the second floor’s chess game...but Halloween’s right around the corner!
: Are you looking forward to that at all?
: Why are you asking me so many questions when I already told you you don’t have to do this to get me to keep your secrets?
: I’m just trying to get to know you better! And also, Senpai and I are in a weird spot right now that we can totally ignore thanks to your presence and participation in this conversation.
: Halloween sucks. Christmas sucks. New Year's sucks. All of the holidays suck and I ain’t lookin’ forward to anything. That do the trick? Are your weird, adult problems solved now?
: Do you just hate fun? Is that what your deal is?
: Part of it, probably.
: She left out the part where Halloween is also her birthday. So I imagine she hates that one the most of all.
: Would it kill you to just, like...not remember things about me? Cause that’d be doin’ me a huge favor, asshat.
: Wait, is it really? How did I not know that?
: Nobody is supposed to know that because-
: We should do something to celebrate. We could get an extra cake for the Halloween party or something.
: Because that always happens. I don’t want to fucking celebrate my stupid ass birthday. It’s just a day. And the further away I am from the center of attention, the better.
: Well damn, girl. Tell us how you really feel.
: Listen, can I leave now? I’m still hungry and I really didn’t wanna waste away my night in a creepy apartment with two creepy adults.
: Senpai being creepy, I understand. Me being creepy? That’s just wrong. I’m the lovable student teacher that everybody gets along with. I’m not allowed to be creepy.
: Nah, you’re pretty fuckin’ creepy. Just not nearly as bad as the guy next to you.
: Would you mind if I came with you? I left something in Yuki’s apartment last time I went over there.
: What is it? Just fuckin’ tell me and I’ll-
: Wait. Yes. That thing. I remember now.
: You may come with me.
: Thanks. I should probably start heading home now anyway, so...
: You can just tell me if you don’t want to be here, Senpai. You don’t have to lie about it.
: Imani-
: Actually, don’t even worry about it. I’ll see you in school tomorrow.
: Actually, don’t even worry about it. I’ll see you in school on Monday.
: I had fun tonight. Sorry nobody else was able to turn up. Even if it was a...calculated absence on all of their behalves.
: I’ll make sure it doesn’t happen again.
: You don’t-
: Just...go get your “thing.” And have a safe trip home. I’ll be back to normal the next time you see me. Promise.
: Hah...
: Have a good night, Imani.
I leave the room with Yumi.
There are no parting words or anything like that.
But before she opens the door and heads into her mother’s apartment, she makes eye contact with me.
Her expression is complicated...and I can’t really tell what it means.
But if I had to take a guess-
I think it was pity.
When I get home, I look in the mirror.
And I confirm that it was.
Then I...
I just go to sleep.
That’s all I do.
Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!
